intent: Add the non-authorizing vertical slice from exact proposal evidence to signed terminal refusal, then join that proposal to one bracketed stable Mission Control owner-store observation. RuntimeState gains atomic collision-safe exact proposal receipts, reserved exact child identities, and a focused exact-identity helper that preserves the public store API while restoring the repo-wide module-size ratchet. Mission Control accepts a candidate only from the exact proposal receipt/idempotency pair and can observe the exact active mission, RUNNING task, canonical parent attempt identity, unique unexpired claim, exact child executor source, task-owned A2A binding, and shape-checked candidate through one joined snapshot of its injected owners. Dedicated snapshot/readback modules keep the copy off the event loop, bind DB/WAL roles by path and inode under a ctime-aware bracket, recover both WALs through explicit read-write snapshot URIs, and reject any terminal/recovery receipt or idempotency intent that contradicts RUNNING state. A shared 900-second lease ceiling is enforced by both lifecycle writers and the readback. The observation explicitly proves neither canonical store custody nor repository-effect authority. The candidate boundary snapshots request, source, diff, and Candidate bytes into an external content-addressed bundle. Release admission runs under env -i before provider or signing credentials are restored, then admitted Foundry and Vibe processes receive mutually exclusive key paths. Distinct processes emit signed non-authorizing receipts. Foundry remains foundry_inconclusive; Vibe is candidate-bound ran=false and unchecked; the result records caller_asserted_no_effect with repository authorization and performed flags false. This packet proves a fail-closed refusal reflex and internally consistent owner-store lineage, not a promotion warrant, canonical store custody, live effect, terminal Mission Control transition, or deployment.

honest_blockers: The joined snapshot uses MissionControlA2AProjection's injected TaskBoard and RuntimeState paths, but callers can still instantiate those owners. Store-instance pinning, protected supervisor custody, and a cross-store epoch remain unproven, so the result is a non-authorizing store observation.
The bracketed pair-copy proves both database/WAL file sets stayed stable during copying, not that their two independent commits were globally atomic.

Two distinct verifier OS processes, PIDs, boot IDs, public keys, and key inodes are observed. Same-user hostile-process independence, supervised provenance, and exclusive private-key custody remain unproven.
Foundry has no real trial ledger or attested Docker CLI, daemon, image, runtime, cleanup, or ignored-release-path chain, so it emits only foundry_inconclusive.
Vibe deliberately does not run: its signed candidate-bound receipt is ran=false and unchecked. No independently admissible Vibe verdict or production trust root exists.
No composition-owned semantic producer emits the exact proposal and candidate bundle under a supervisor-owned store, and Mission Control refuses these process receipts as promotion warrants.
No sealed effect capability, repository mutation, external-owner terminal receipt, or TaskBoard terminal transition exists in this slice.
Two clean-restart positive runs with a real provider, exactly one authorized effect, and exactly one terminal receipt per run have not been demonstrated.
Every stacked PR requires external human approval; passing packet, local, or CI verification does not satisfy that gate.
interface_mismatches: A2A packet/delivery IDs and Mission Control attempt/claim IDs are distinct modalities and remain separate fields; aliases can never satisfy the owner-store lineage check.
A stable owner-store observation is not a bearer capability and cannot convert to an EffectWarrant; the effect owner must perform a fresh fence CAS.
TaskBoard and RuntimeState are independent WAL databases, so the observation explicitly exposes its bracketed snapshot limitation instead of claiming global atomicity.

Foundry evaluation, Vibe observation, signed evidence, RuntimeState attestation, repository-effect authority, terminal receipt, and TaskBoard projection are distinct authority modalities; no earlier layer may be promoted into a later one.
A signed process receipt proves key possession for one payload, not exclusive private-key custody or hostile-process independence.
Runtime receipts record evidence but are not bearer capabilities; an effect evaluator must require a separately sealed nominal capability and exact candidate binding.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this Fleet segment, including exact proposal support, joined owner snapshot/readback modules, the shared Mission Control lease ceiling, RuntimeState exact-identity extraction, candidate/no-effect bundles, admitted verifier commands, exact child-identity reservation, parity reseal, and this packet. External evidence bundles, signed receipts, and RuntimeState rows are append-only evidence and are not deleted or reinterpreted by a Git rollback.
